title: Createverse
body:
# Createverse 
Createverse is Create mod focused Minecraft modpack...

...and for now there's that.

It's main purpose is to make unique experience combined by new features and looks. Playing with just Create installed isn't as great as having it combined in a modpack with 140+ mods.

Create for machinery. ComputerCraft for coding and Create mod integrations. Farmer's Delight for a wider range of dishes with Create's farming possibilities. Macaw's decorations mods for a better finish of the envelope that will cover the creations from Create. And Biomes O' Plenty to make the world more diverse, and of course less repetitive.

> Resource packs by End_Rage, Spydnel, Os and LopyLuna do most default visual stuff perfectly, but I also plan to refurnish entire ui by myself to make the experience truly unique.

### Main mods:
- Create + addons
- CC: Tweaked
- Farmer's Delight + addons
- Macaw's [Bridges, Doors, Furnitures, etc.]
- Biomes O' Plenty 

###  Additional info:
> Modpack is still in it's early development. I'm not planing on adding anything new for now, can't focus on work, uni and projects at the same time.
